name: mudra_intro_static_pose_medoids_v1
split: PhoneWebcam intro static model evaluation; inferred filename groups, originals and horizontal mirrors grouped together
limitations: Still-image nearest-medoid experiment, not a dynamic sign or sentence recognizer.
Folder labels are user-confirmed but not independently reviewed by an ISL-fluent signer.
Filename-derived groups are conservative guesses and signer identity is unknown.
Many labels have no held-out source group; live performance for those labels is unmeasured.
Do not tune weights or thresholds on the held-out test groups.
The split policy was adjusted during setup; test metrics are exploratory, not a confirmatory benchmark.

evaluation_on_our_test.note: Our test clips come from the same signers as the word model's training data; the static model was built from other people's phone photos. The comparison therefore favours the word model.
